location_description: A vast nocturnal Victorian poison greenhouse with black wrought-iron ribs, fogged glass panes, a huge moon beyond the roof, tangled sentient vines, toxic bell flowers, blue aconites and a round veined marble pedestal at its center

characters.name: La Graine Noire
characters.emotion: dormant intelligence, patient and quietly amused
characters.position: hidden inside the closed chest at center frame
characters.visual_description: A glossy black botanical seed shaped like a small anatomical heart, split by one thin violet seam, with tiny rootlets like veins and no human face, limbs or readable species
characters.wardrobe: Its only covering is a wet obsidian shell with a subtle violet inner glow and delicate vein-like roots that move with deliberate intelligence

camera.movement: slow descending push toward the pedestal

action: At midnight an ornate black chest pulses on the central pedestal; on every pulse all nearby poison flowers recoil from it as if sharing one nervous body
lighting: cold full moon through fogged glass with a faint violet pulse leaking from the chest seams
mood: playful gothic suspense with a first trace of organic unease

render.negative_prompt: photorealism, human skin, ordinary people, gore, blood, daylight, modern objects, text, subtitles, logo, watermark
